headline: Sudan Offers Russia Red Sea Zone and Mineral Deposits in Moscow Talks
summary: Sudan's army chief offered Russia access to a Red Sea zone along with gold and copper deposits during talks in Moscow, involving a strategic maritime trade corridor.
why: The Red Sea is one of the most critical global energy and cargo shipping channels. Access to naval or logistics bases and mineral resources in the area has major geopolitical implications.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Sudan proposed offering Red Sea logistics access and mineral concessions to Russia.
